items.title: Observed whole-form lead in high-coverage networks

source.label: DOC pathway context
filters: Original elongated and broad whole-network classes

metricDefinitions.label: SD ratio contrast
metricDefinitions.definition: The geometric-mean receiving/tributary-mixture SD ratio for broad networks divided by the corresponding elongated ratio, after shared calendar/year projection.

caveats: The follow-up is exploratory after previous DOC results were seen.
Regions and whole forms remain confounded; the contrast does not isolate a shape effect.
The ratio concerns observed fluctuation amplitude, not DOC concentration or mass removal.

source.label: Whole-network sampling inventory
filters: Area-comparable means catchment area ratio at most two
Both receivers must have enough common source/outlet DOC under current source-role availability

metricDefinitions.label: Candidate pair
metricDefinitions.definition: One elongated and one broad network in the same HUC4; stations can occur in multiple candidate pairs.

caveats: Candidate combinations are not independent field replicates.
Source-role sampling availability is specific to this ST357 study, not all potential public observations.

items.title: Area and flow shares compared on identical months

source.label: Paired monthly-flow sensitivity
filters: Positive measured monthly discharge at every source and receiver
At least 24 common months, three sampled years and six calendar-month categories
Complete catchment systems resampled together 5,000 times

metricDefinitions.label: Paired log-SD change
metricDefinitions.definition: Flow-weighted minus area-weighted log receiving/mixture SD on the same common dates.

caveats: Monthly discharge is not simultaneous event mixing or a measured travel time.
The interval spans zero; replacing weights does not establish an overall improvement.

preview.note: One aggregate record calculated from the specified observed population.

items.title: A mapped lake lies between the Loch Vale gauges and outlet

source.label: Cropped monitored river paths
filters: Icy Brook, Andrews Creek and The Loch outlet
Actual directed NHD gauge-to-receiver paths with station measures

metricDefinitions.label: Tagged lake length
metricDefinitions.definition: The common route traverses 0.413 km of lake-tagged COMID 13676, waterbody 11922; its length is counted once in the common corridor.

caveats: Mapped path length is not waterbody volume or residence time.
Missing lake tags on other routes do not establish absence of storage.
